stem: MetroPlay runs latency-sensitive game matchmaking near city users but keeps account-management services in a full AWS Region. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Place matchmaking services in a Local Zone near end users
Place account-management databases in a Wavelength Zone only
Host both tiers on one Outposts deployment at a company facility
Place all components in one Availability Zone in the Region
Keep core account-management services in the parent Region

rationale: Local Zones are designed for low-latency workloads near users, which fits matchmaking response requirements. Keeping account-management services in the parent Region preserves access to broader Regional services and operations. Hosting both tiers on one Outposts deployment changes the operating model and does not match the stated split-edge architecture target. Moving account-management databases to Wavelength-only placement conflicts with the requirement to keep that tier in full Regional environment. Placing all components in one AZ removes the intended distributed placement strategy.
